user.title: Hot water tank sensors
user.description: Select the sensors of your electric water heater. TankWise only reads them; it never controls any device.

data_description.temperature_sensor: Temperature probe of the tank (upper part).
data_description.power_sensor: Power currently drawn by the heating element.
data_description.energy_sensor: Cumulative energy of the heating element (total or total increasing).

optional.title: Optional inputs
optional.description: These inputs improve the plan. All of them can be changed later in the options.

data_description.solar_forecast_sensor: Forecast.Solar or Solcast energy forecast sensor. The hourly curve will be used by the planner in a later version.
data_description.surplus_sensor: Power available as surplus right now.
data_description.presence_entity: When off, TankWise switches to holiday mode (no grid heating).
data_description.bottom_temperature_sensor: Second probe in the lower part of the tank, if available.

error.invalid_unit: The entity has an unsupported unit of measurement.
error.invalid_state_class: The energy sensor must have state class 'total' or 'total_increasing'.

data_description.water_region: Used to estimate the mains water temperature for each month.
data_description.mains_water_temperature: Leave empty to use the monthly value for the selected region.
data_description.min_useful_temperature: Water below this temperature is not considered useful hot water.
data_description.cutoff_power_threshold: Below this power after heating, the thermostat is considered to have cut off (tank full).
data_description.comfort_level: Percentile of the learned demand the plan must cover.
